observations.iso12800-prior: Trained/base look close. Unit has grid in building sky and banding/color on canopy edge. ORACLE target-term output has no comparable strong grid but still does not restore GT radial canopy cords. ORACLE discrepancy-term output carries the visible sky grid and canopy-edge banding, like unit.
observations.highlights: Unit has green casts. ORACLE discrepancy-only output has much stronger green/cyan casts on building and green canopy edge. ORACLE target-only output itself has strong pink/magenta on canopy edge and building, absent exact GT. The two terms partially cancel visibly; it would be incorrect to claim the target-only term is harmless in highlights.

scope: Both oracle rows use exact synthetic GT to split a fixed operator. They are diagnostic counterfactuals, not deployable inference or trained models. No GFX oracle is constructed.
